entries.en: The golfer selected a niblick for the steep approach shot.
entries.zh: 高尔夫球手选了一支九号铁杆来打这记需要陡升的攻果岭球。

entries.en: Her musicological research focuses on early printed songbooks.
entries.zh: 她的音乐学研究聚焦于早期印制的歌集。

entries.en: The drawing labels the lacrimal gland above the eye.
entries.zh: 图中标出了眼睛上方的泪腺。

entries.en: When I think back, I remember the smell of fresh bread.
entries.zh: 回想起来，我还记得新鲜面包的香味。

entries.en: The recipe needs more than a cup of milk.
entries.zh: 这个食谱需要一杯以上的牛奶。

entries.en: Visitors can borrow folding stools for free.
entries.zh: 游客可以免费借用折叠凳。

entries.en: I watched the rehearsal from start to finish.
entries.zh: 我从头到尾看完了彩排。

entries.en: The island was left in a state of nature.
entries.zh: 这座岛被保留在原始的自然状态。

entries.en: Please keep personal phone calls outside work time.
entries.zh: 请在工作时间以外打私人电话。

entries.en: The museum displayed sacerdotal robes beside the ceremonial vessels.
entries.zh: 博物馆把祭司袍陈列在仪式器皿旁边。

entries.en: Ducks floated on the millpond behind the old mill.
entries.zh: 鸭子漂浮在老磨坊后面的水车贮水池上。

entries.en: The exhibition included a leather phylactery with its straps.
entries.zh: 展览中有一个带着皮带的皮制经匣。

entries.en: The guidebook has been out of print for years.
entries.zh: 这本旅行指南已经绝版多年了。

entries.en: They searched far and wide for the missing dog.
entries.zh: 他们到处寻找那只走失的狗。

entries.en: Can you account for the difference between these totals?
entries.zh: 你能解释这些总数之间的差异吗？

entries.en: I need time to think over your proposal.
entries.zh: 我需要时间仔细考虑你的提议。

entries.en: We need to find out why the pump stopped.
entries.zh: 我们需要查明水泵为什么停了。

entries.en: Hold the railing firmly and do not let go.
entries.zh: 握紧栏杆，不要松手。

entries.en: The theologian described the Father and Son as consubstantial.
entries.zh: 神学家把圣父与圣子描述为同体的。

entries.en: He hyperbolically claimed that the queue stretched across the continent.
entries.zh: 他夸张地声称，队伍长得横跨整个大陆。

entries.en: The diagram shows an unbranched carbon chain.
entries.zh: 图中展示了一条无支链的碳链。

entries.en: Her term of office ends after the annual meeting.
entries.zh: 她的任期在年会之后结束。

entries.en: Some herbs, for example mint, grow well in pots.
entries.zh: 有些香草，例如薄荷，在盆里长得很好。

entries.meaningZh: 一种由杜松子酒和苦艾酒混合而成的饮料
entries.en: She ordered a gin and it before dinner.
entries.zh: 她晚饭前点了一杯杜松子酒与苦艾酒调成的鸡尾酒。

entries.en: He copied the short inscription word for word.
entries.zh: 他逐字抄下了那段短铭文。

entries.en: We cannot sit by while the public garden deteriorates.
entries.zh: 我们不能在公共花园衰败时无动于衷。

entries.en: We could not find a taxi for love or money.
entries.zh: 我们无论如何也找不到出租车。

entries.en: The inspector reviewed the aircraft's airworthiness before approving the flight.
entries.zh: 检查员在批准飞行前审查了飞机的适航性。

entries.en: The weaponless guard raised both hands and stepped back.
entries.zh: 那名没有武器的守卫举起双手，向后退去。

entries.en: The hotel may add on a charge for late checkout.
entries.zh: 酒店可能会对延迟退房附加费用。

entries.en: The arrow shows the direction along a line of force.
entries.zh: 箭头表示沿着一条力线的方向。

entries.en: The closing remarks come after the final presentation.
entries.zh: 闭幕致辞排在最后一场报告之后。

entries.en: I will stand by you during the difficult negotiations.
entries.zh: 在艰难的谈判中，我会支持你。

entries.en: We need to get rid of these broken shelves.
entries.zh: 我们需要清理掉这些坏架子。

entries.en: An armorial shield hung above the castle doorway.
entries.zh: 城堡门口上方悬挂着一面带纹章的盾牌。

entries.en: The essay traces deistic ideas in eighteenth-century philosophy.
entries.zh: 这篇文章追溯了十八世纪哲学中的自然神论思想。

entries.en: The shopkeeper entered each sale in a book of account.
entries.zh: 店主把每笔销售都记入账簿。

entries.en: The play debates whether the prisoner should be put to death.
entries.zh: 这部戏讨论是否应该处死那名囚犯。

entries.en: Please give way to passengers leaving the train.
entries.zh: 请给下车的乘客让路。

entries.en: The fireworks will go off after the final song.
entries.zh: 最后一首歌结束后，烟花将燃放。

entries.en: A delegate raised a point of order before the vote.
entries.zh: 一位代表在投票前提出了程序异议。

entries.en: The kitchen scenes felt remarkably true to life.
entries.zh: 那些厨房场景让人觉得格外真实。

entries.en: We reuse packaging as much as possible.
entries.zh: 我们尽可能重复使用包装材料。

entries.en: Keep the children within eyeshot while they explore the beach.
entries.zh: 孩子们在海滩探索时，要让他们保持在视野之内。

entries.en: The lowermost drawer held old maps and receipts.
entries.zh: 最底下的抽屉里放着旧地图和收据。

entries.en: You can still back out before signing the agreement.
entries.zh: 签署协议之前，你仍可以退出。

entries.en: The chair will call the meeting to order at noon.
entries.zh: 主席将于中午宣布开会。

entries.meaningZh: 看起来与（某人或某物）相像
entries.en: Those distant hills look like sleeping animals.
entries.zh: 远处那些山丘看起来像沉睡的动物。

entries.en: The drama club meets weekly during the school year.
entries.zh: 戏剧社在学年期间每周聚会一次。

entries.en: We will catch it if we leave the gate open again.
entries.zh: 如果我们又没关大门，就会挨骂。

entries.en: On one hand, the apartment is affordable; on the other, it is tiny.
entries.zh: 一方面，这套公寓价格可以负担；另一方面，它很小。

entries.en: The neglected garden began to go to pot.
entries.zh: 无人照料的花园开始荒废。

entries.en: The proposal would sweepingly reform the entire registration system.
entries.zh: 这项提案将彻底改革整个登记制度。

entries.en: The recorder ran uninterruptedly throughout the night.
entries.zh: 录音机整夜不间断地运行。

entries.en: The chart gives each signal's frequency in kilohertz.
entries.zh: 图表以千赫为单位列出了每个信号的频率。

entries.en: Old memories come back whenever I hear that tune.
entries.zh: 每当听到那首曲子，往事就浮现在我的脑海。

entries.en: They planned to play a joke on their cousin.
entries.zh: 他们打算对表亲开个玩笑。

entries.en: Please send on any letters that arrive after I leave.
entries.zh: 我走后如果有信到，请帮忙转寄。

entries.en: He wished us good day and closed the shop door.
entries.zh: 他向我们道别，关上了店门。

entries.en: We hope you will be well enough to join us soon.
entries.zh: 我们希望你很快就能身体康复，来和我们相聚。

entries.en: The astronomy lesson described the precessional cycle called the great year.
entries.zh: 天文学课介绍了称为大年的岁差周期。

entries.en: The portrait shows the czarina wearing an elaborate jeweled crown.
entries.zh: 肖像中的沙皇皇后戴着华丽的宝石王冠。

entries.en: Pass me that metal thingamajig beside the toolbox.
entries.zh: 把工具箱旁边那个金属玩意儿递给我。

entries.en: We discussed the misunderstanding face to face after lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭后，我们面对面讨论了那场误会。

entries.en: The committee will act on the inspector's recommendations.
entries.zh: 委员会将按照检查员的建议采取行动。

entries.en: She will be on cloud nine if her proposal wins.
entries.zh: 如果提案获胜，她会欣喜若狂。

entries.en: The little boat managed to come through the storm.
entries.zh: 那条小船设法安然度过了风暴。

entries.en: We agreed on a course of action before leaving.
entries.zh: 我们出发前商定了行动方针。

entries.en: It is high time we repaired the broken gate.
entries.zh: 我们早该修理那扇坏掉的大门了。

entries.en: The study compared the antigenic properties of the samples.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了样本的抗原特性。

entries.en: The lecturer wrote noradrenaline beside its structural formula.
entries.zh: 讲师在结构式旁写下了去甲肾上腺素的名称。

entries.en: The upper windows look out over the river valley.
entries.zh: 楼上的窗户俯瞰着河谷。

entries.en: The manager must answer for the missing equipment.
entries.zh: 经理必须对丢失的设备作出解释并负责。

entries.en: The table compares the rate of return for each project.
entries.zh: 这张表比较了各个项目的收益率。

entries.en: The soft lighting shows the sculpture to advantage.
entries.zh: 柔和的灯光很好地展现了雕塑的美感。

entries.en: The counselor explained that neither partner was obliged to have sex.
entries.zh: 咨询师解释说，伴侣双方都没有必须发生性关系的义务。

entries.en: Put the agreement on paper before any work begins.
entries.zh: 任何工作开始前，先把协议写下来。

entries.en: Please put out the candle before leaving the room.
entries.zh: 离开房间前，请熄灭蜡烛。

entries.en: He tardily acknowledged the invitation after the deadline had passed.
entries.zh: 截止日期过后，他才迟迟回复邀请。

entries.en: The open sea gave her a sense of boundlessness.
entries.zh: 开阔的大海让她感到无边无际。

entries.en: The fantasy story gives its heroine the power of psychokinesis.
entries.zh: 这篇奇幻故事赋予女主角心灵致动的能力。

entries.en: The children hoped to play a trick on their uncle.
entries.zh: 孩子们想捉弄一下他们的叔叔。

entries.en: Two servers will wait on guests in the garden.
entries.zh: 两位服务员将在花园里招待宾客。

entries.en: Can you work out the total without a calculator?
entries.zh: 你能不用计算器算出总数吗？

entries.en: The route is longer, but at any rate it is safer.
entries.zh: 这条路线更长，但至少更安全。

entries.en: The hotel gardens extend to the edge of the lake.
entries.zh: 酒店花园一直延伸到湖边。

entries.en: Approving the minutes is the first order of business.
entries.zh: 批准会议记录是第一项议事内容。

entries.en: An unobservant visitor might miss the tiny carving above the door.
entries.zh: 不留心的游客可能会错过门上方那件小雕刻。

entries.en: She kept her bankbook in a locked desk drawer.
entries.zh: 她把银行存折放在上锁的书桌抽屉里。

entries.en: He spoke boastfully about winning the neighborhood chess tournament.
entries.zh: 他自夸地谈起赢得社区国际象棋比赛的事。

entries.en: A small supply of spices can go a long way.
entries.zh: 少量香料就能发挥很大的作用。

entries.en: The old farmhouse is for sale this autumn.
entries.zh: 那幢旧农舍今年秋天待售。

entries.en: We need to get off at the next stop.
entries.zh: 我们需要在下一站下车。

entries.en: The next lesson will build on today's discussion.
entries.zh: 下一课将以今天的讨论为基础。

entries.en: We arrived at the theater ten minutes before show time.
entries.zh: 我们在开演前十分钟到了剧院。

entries.en: The case study describes a pregnancy she was able to carry to term.
entries.zh: 这个案例描述了她能够足月完成的一次妊娠。

entries.en: He grew shirty when asked to move his car.
entries.zh: 有人让他挪车时，他生起气来。

entries.en: Their new goalkeeper is a humdinger with remarkable reflexes.
entries.zh: 他们的新守门员极为出色，反应非常敏捷。

entries.en: Retirement initially left him with a feeling of purposelessness.
entries.zh: 退休最初让他觉得生活没有目标。

entries.en: The lecture examined the role of courts in maintaining the rule of law.
entries.zh: 讲座探讨了法院在维护法治方面的作用。

entries.en: Several guests decided to stay on after the wedding.
entries.zh: 几位客人决定婚礼后继续留下来。

entries.en: She added a handwritten thank you to the parcel.
entries.zh: 她在包裹里附上了一张手写的感谢便条。

entries.en: Please give back the money you borrowed last week.
entries.zh: 请归还你上周借的钱。

entries.en: The farmer allowed a right of way across the field.
entries.zh: 农民允许人们从这块田里通行。

entries.en: The walkers crossed the narrow bridge one after another.
entries.zh: 徒步者一个接一个地走过那座窄桥。

entries.en: The river deposited fresh alluvium along the inside of the bend.
entries.zh: 河流在弯道内侧沉积了新的冲积物。

entries.en: A miasmic haze hung over the polluted marsh.
entries.zh: 受污染的沼泽上空笼罩着一层有害的雾气。

entries.en: The pernickety editor questioned every tiny change in punctuation.
entries.zh: 那位爱挑剔的编辑对每个微小的标点改动都提出了疑问。

entries.en: Please call out your number when you reach the desk.
entries.zh: 走到柜台时，请大声报出你的号码。

entries.en: The fair offered a game of chance with small prizes.
entries.zh: 集市上有一种靠运气赢小奖品的游戏。

entries.en: We plan to travel to the coast in early spring.
entries.zh: 我们计划早春去海边旅行。

entries.en: The crew worked against time to repair the ferry.
entries.zh: 船员们争分夺秒地修理渡轮。

entries.en: The new curtains make the room a good deal brighter.
entries.zh: 新窗帘让房间亮堂了许多。

entries.en: We must draw a line between useful advice and constant interference.
entries.zh: 我们必须在有用的建议与不断的干涉之间划清界线。

entries.en: I will attend to the broken latch after lunch.
entries.zh: 午饭后我会处理那个坏门闩。

entries.en: Dust lay thick on the unswept floor.
entries.zh: 没扫过的地板上积着厚厚的灰尘。

entries.en: Spilled oil can befoul the entire stretch of shoreline.
entries.zh: 泄漏的石油会污染整段海岸线。

entries.en: The old branches overarch the narrow garden path.
entries.zh: 古老的枝条在狭窄的花园小径上方拱起。

entries.en: Please report the broken railing to the caretaker at once.
entries.zh: 请立刻向管理员报告栏杆损坏的情况。

entries.en: The mechanic checked whether the machine was out of gear.
entries.zh: 机械师检查了机器是否处于脱挡状态。

entries.en: Please pass on the message to the evening team.
entries.zh: 请把这个消息传给晚班团队。

entries.en: We can talk about the budget after the presentation.
entries.zh: 演示结束后，我们可以讨论预算。

entries.en: The seedlings need at least six hours of sunlight.
entries.zh: 幼苗需要至少六小时的日照。

entries.en: You may leave out the final paragraph if space is limited.
entries.zh: 如果篇幅有限，可以省去最后一段。

entries.en: The empty swing moved back and forth in the breeze.
entries.zh: 空秋千在微风中来回摆动。

entries.en: The philosopher questioned the ultimacy of pleasure as a moral goal.
entries.zh: 哲学家质疑了快乐作为道德目标的终极性。

entries.en: The guide spoke informatively about the building's changing uses.
entries.zh: 导游介绍建筑用途的变迁时提供了丰富的信息。

entries.en: The hospital inventory listed haloperidol among the stored medicines.
entries.zh: 医院的库存清单把氟哌啶醇列在储存药品之中。

entries.en: He still has a thick head of hair at seventy.
entries.zh: 他七十岁时仍有一头浓密的头发。

entries.en: She decided to break with her former business partner.
entries.zh: 她决定与以前的生意伙伴断绝关系。

entries.en: Visitors can try out the new bicycle on the track.
entries.zh: 游客可以在跑道上试骑这辆新自行车。

entries.en: The recruits performed an about turn on command.
entries.zh: 新兵们听到口令后做了一个向后转。

entries.en: More details may come to light during the investigation.
entries.zh: 调查期间可能会有更多细节显露出来。

entries.en: Marine ecology is her chosen field of study.
entries.zh: 海洋生态学是她选择的研究领域。

entries.en: We recorded the seedlings' growth week by week.
entries.zh: 我们一周又一周地记录幼苗的生长情况。

entries.en: The musician played a gentle melody on the clavichord.
entries.zh: 乐手用击弦古钢琴弹奏了一段轻柔的旋律。

entries.en: The patentee licensed her invention to a small manufacturer.
entries.zh: 这位专利获得者把自己的发明许可给一家小制造商使用。

entries.en: The speaker will eulogise the founder's dedication to public education.
entries.zh: 演讲者将颂扬创办人对公共教育的奉献。

entries.en: The curator wanted to preserve the fragile manuscript at any cost.
entries.zh: 馆长无论如何都想保存这份脆弱的手稿。

entries.en: He finally found the courage to ask her out.
entries.zh: 他终于鼓起勇气约她出去。

entries.en: The young singer dreamed of reaching the big time.
entries.zh: 那位年轻歌手梦想着取得巨大成功，跻身一流行列。

entries.en: I am only too happy to help with the preparations.
entries.zh: 我非常乐意帮忙准备。

entries.en: We hope to get word about the repairs by Friday.
entries.zh: 我们希望周五前能得到有关维修的消息。

entries.en: We should feel out the committee before making a proposal.
entries.zh: 提出提案前，我们应该先试探委员会的意见。

entries.en: We have no fixed route and will play it by ear.
entries.zh: 我们没有固定路线，会随机行事。

entries.en: A last-minute switcheroo put the pianist in the opening slot.
entries.zh: 最后一刻的突然调换让钢琴家改为开场演出。

entries.en: In the story, a bewitchment keeps the castle asleep.
entries.zh: 故事中，一道妖术使城堡一直沉睡。

entries.en: The mural depicts a cyclopean figure carrying a huge stone.
entries.zh: 壁画描绘了一个扛着巨石的独眼巨人形象。

entries.en: The buses had stopped, so we had to leg it home.
entries.zh: 公共汽车停运了，我们只好步行回家。

entries.en: The receipt shows the exact amount of money paid.
entries.zh: 收据上显示了实际支付的金额。

entries.en: The archive still had a line-at-a-time printer for its old computer.
entries.zh: 档案馆仍为那台旧电脑保留着一台行式打印机。

entries.en: Keep the original woodwork as far as possible.
entries.zh: 尽可能保留原来的木制结构。

entries.en: Students can progress to advanced classes after completing this course.
entries.zh: 学生完成这门课后，可以进入高级课程继续学习。

entries.en: Day after day, he returned to repair the damaged wall.
entries.zh: 他日复一日地回来修理那堵受损的墙。

entries.en: The ballad praises a leal companion who never deserts his friend.
entries.zh: 这首民谣赞美了一位从不抛弃朋友的忠实伙伴。

entries.en: The smaller boxer managed to outfight his taller opponent.
entries.zh: 体型较小的拳击手设法打败了比他高的对手。

entries.en: The old radio still works after a fashion.
entries.zh: 那台旧收音机还勉强能用。

entries.en: The dog refused to go away from the picnic blanket.
entries.zh: 那只狗不肯离开野餐毯。

entries.en: As yet, we have received no reply from the supplier.
entries.zh: 至今我们仍未收到供应商的回复。

entries.en: She took some time off to visit her family.
entries.zh: 她请了几天假去探望家人。

entries.en: I am sick of hearing the same excuse every morning.
entries.zh: 我已经厌烦了每天早上听同一个借口。

entries.en: First and last, the trip was a worthwhile experience.
entries.zh: 总的说来，这次旅行是一次值得的经历。

entries.en: The timing is all important when baking this delicate cake.
entries.zh: 烘焙这种精致蛋糕时，时间的把握非常重要。

entries.meaningZh: 一种户外穿的防风夹克
entries.en: She packed a windcheater for the coastal walk.
entries.zh: 她为海边徒步装进了一件防风夹克。

entries.en: The garden includes several leguminous plants beside the fence.
entries.zh: 花园篱笆旁种着几种豆科植物。

entries.en: A time and motion study helped reorganize the packing process.
entries.zh: 一项工时动作研究帮助重新安排了包装流程。

entries.en: The factory commissioned a time-and-motion study of the assembly line.
entries.zh: 工厂委托人员对装配线进行工时动作测定。

entries.en: Better lighting can bring about a noticeable change in the room.
entries.zh: 更好的照明可以使房间发生明显变化。

entries.en: His muddy boots looked out of place in the elegant hall.
entries.zh: 他的泥靴在雅致的大厅里显得格格不入。

entries.en: The hotel staff waited on the guests hand and foot.
entries.zh: 酒店员工无微不至地伺候着客人。

entries.en: We often look back on that summer with affection.
entries.zh: 我们常常满怀温情地回忆那个夏天。

entries.en: The portrait shows the athlete in the prime of life.
entries.zh: 肖像展现了那位运动员正值壮年的样子。

entries.en: The committee condemned his unwarrantable interference in the selection process.
entries.zh: 委员会谴责了他对选拔程序无正当理由的干涉。

entries.en: The lamp glowed murkily through its dusty glass shade.
entries.zh: 灯透过积灰的玻璃灯罩发出昏暗的光。

entries.en: The landscapist set up her easel beside the lake.
entries.zh: 风景画家在湖边架起了画架。

entries.en: The children began to warm to the idea of camping.
entries.zh: 孩子们开始喜欢露营这个主意。

entries.en: The couple decided not to be intimate until they felt comfortable.
entries.zh: 这对伴侣决定等双方都觉得自在后再发生性关系。

entries.en: The museum hosts a lantern exhibition each year.
entries.zh: 博物馆每年举办一次灯笼展。

entries.en: She added a handful of berries for good measure.
entries.zh: 她又额外加了一把浆果。

entries.en: The old pear tree flowers every year.
entries.zh: 那棵老梨树每年都开花。

entries.en: Please do not step on the newly planted grass.
entries.zh: 请不要踩刚种下的草。

entries.en: With her patience and skill, she could go far.
entries.zh: 凭她的耐心和技艺，她会大有前途。
